requirements.why_checkable: The Phase 2 completion path can be checked for Phase 3 invocation.

requirements.quote:
The Phase 3 decision function is invoked on completion of Phase 2, or
   when any of the following events occur:

      a) when routes in the Loc-RIB to local destinations have changed
requirements.condition: Routes in the Loc-RIB to local destinations have changed
requirements.why_checkable: A change to a local-destination route can be checked for a dissemination trigger.

requirements.quote:
The Phase 3 decision function is invoked on completion of Phase 2, or
   when any of the following events occur:

      a) when routes in the Loc-RIB to local destinations have changed

      b) when locally generated routes learned by means outside of BGP
         have changed
requirements.condition: Locally generated routes learned by means outside BGP have changed
requirements.why_checkable: A change to an externally learned local route can be checked for a dissemination trigger.

requirements.quote:
The Phase 3 decision function is invoked on completion of Phase 2, or
   when any of the following events occur:

      a) when routes in the Loc-RIB to local destinations have changed

      b) when locally generated routes learned by means outside of BGP
         have changed

      c) when a new BGP speaker connection has been established
requirements.condition: A new BGP speaker connection has been established
requirements.why_checkable: Connection establishment can be checked for Phase 3 invocation.

requirements.quote:
The Phase 3 function is a separate process that completes when it has
   no further work to do.  The Phase 3 Routing Decision function is
   blocked from running while the Phase 2 decision function is in
   process.
requirements.required_behavior: Execute Phase 3 as a separate process.
requirements.why_checkable: The decision-function organization can be inspected for a distinct Phase 3 process.

requirements.quote:

requirements.quote:
When the updating of the Adj-RIBs-Out and the Routing Table is
   complete, the local BGP speaker runs the Update-Send process of 9.2.
requirements.condition: Updating the Adj-RIBs-Out and the Routing Table is complete
requirements.required_behavior: Run the Update-Send process of Section 9.2.
requirements.why_checkable: Completion of both updates can be checked for Update-Send invocation.
